text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That girl... who lost the race, she still came to 
school today...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, I wonder what would make her 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That’s it— The flower meaning of chamomile is 
'Strength born in adversity'...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I’ll make some chamomile tea and give it 
to her. I hope it can cheer her up...!
